audit.why: packet.levelChart (Skill/Skill/Skill/Zac/Skill/Zac/Zac) matches full phases[].side and content win[] row for row, and 51.43% over 593 games fits a lane Locke holds early and loses on items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike windows are right but carry no numbers. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — at rank 1 that is a 21-second punish window, the single biggest lever in the lane — and Unstable Matter chips percent max health every 5 seconds.
audit.why: 'Punish the cooldown' is the page's own advice in breakdown.cooldowns and it never says how long the cooldown is. The 21s is what makes his level 4-5 spike survivable.
audit.corrected: 21s and the 5s W added to spikes[0] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The revive is described vaguely as 'blob revive' and 'rezzes out of it'. Riot's text is specific: on taking fatal damage Zac splits into 4 bloblets that try to recombine, and he revives with health scaled to the surviving bloblets. That detail is the actionable part — the counterplay is stepping on the bloblets, not out-damaging the revive.
audit.why: Against an execute champion this is the decisive interaction: a landed Purgatory execute does not end Zac unless the bloblets are dealt with. Stating the mechanic precisely turns a warning into an instruction.
audit.corrected: Four bloblets and the recombine condition stated in spikes[1], mid and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Zac's E carries a grounding flag in the derived data, but Riot's description is only 'attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect on enemies.
audit.why: Per the rule that Riot's description outranks a misfiring derived flag, I asserted nothing about Zac grounding Locke's E. Left alone and flagged.
sources: enemyKit E text vs its grounding flag

edits.before: Zac's blob passive plus Q double-grab and E stretch give him sustain and pick threat; his level-4 spike lets his Elastic Slingshot engage out-range your E, and his healing blobs undo your Q poke and W chip.
edits.after: Zac's blob passive plus Q double-grab and E stretch give him sustain and pick threat; Elastic Slingshot out-ranges your E but costs him 21 seconds at rank 1, and Unstable Matter chips percent max health every 5s.

edits.before: Even-ish window: your R Purgatory totem can execute Zac under its threshold if he commits, but his passive revive from blobs means you must clear the goo before the totem finishes or he rezzes out of it.
edits.after: Even-ish window: Purgatory executes Zac under its threshold if he commits, but fatal damage splits him into four bloblets and he revives if any survive — step on the goo first or the execute just resets him.

edits.before: Level 4-5 tilts to Zac as his Slingshot engage and sustain come online, then 6 is roughly even because your R totem can execute him if he over-commits, provided you clear his blobs so he can't rez out. Respect his E pick threat.
edits.after: Level 4-5 tilts to Zac as Slingshot and his sustain come online, then 6 is roughly even: your totem executes an over-committed Zac, but only if you step on the bloblets first — he revives off any that survive. Punish the 21s his E is down.

edits.before: Use R Purgatory only after clearing his passive blobs
edits.after: Clear his bloblets before Purgatory finishes him

notes: Page was already accurate — corrections are precision, not repair: the passive splits him into four bloblets on fatal damage and he revives off the survivors, which is the one thing that beats an execute, and Elastic Slingshot's 21s at rank 1 is the punish window the page kept referring to without naming. Zac's E carries a grounding flag Riot's text does not support, so nothing was written that depends on it.
